title: Cobb Vanth
description: As the marshal of Mos Pelgo. Cobb Vanth took it upon himself to keep the peace for the people of the small and distant Tatooine town. The townsfolk there trusted him as a capable protector. He fought for the town's initial peace in Mandalorian armor that once belonged to Boba Fett that he got from a group of Jawas, In that armor, he was able to drive off those terrorizing the town. From then on, he made sure the streets were safe.
